# Recipe 1.1 v2 fixtures — SYNTHETIC

These files are **synthetic fixtures**, written locally to model the public JazzHR detail-page structure
(`{board}.applytojob.com/apply/{postingId}/{slug}`: `<h1>` title, `title="Location"` attribute, `#job-description`,
optional `application/ld+json` JobPosting). They are **not captures** of strike.applytojob.com and no network request was
made to produce them. Facts used are only those already recorded locally in Phase 2J
(`targeted-evidence-facts.ts`: Strike Journeyman Electrician, Houston, TX, posting ID `5DyLJo3Zgw`, "Full Time").
The description text and the date in the JSON-LD variant are placeholders, labeled as such, used only to test parsing.
